name: astral-orchestrator
description: Beginner-friendly orchestration with Comet, Orbit, Event Horizon, explicit opt-in Singularity, Pulsar, Morph, and Constellation modes for planning, delegating, verifying, and reviewing project work in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Simple, risk-aware delivery for any project.
interface.longDescription: Astral Orchestrator offers Comet, Orbit, Event Horizon, Singularity, Pulsar, Morph, and Constellation modes with table-form live status. Singularity is explicit opt-in: one verified Sol primary self-reviews with no subagents or fresh reviewer. On current Codex hosts, Orbit, Event Horizon, and Pulsar use native MultiAgentsV2 workers pinned to Luna Max or Terra High by default and a fresh Sol High reviewer; configured efforts remain adjustable. Every explicit opt-in mode never runs automatically; Event Horizon overrides high-risk Singularity work.
defaultPrompt: Use Astral: Orbit default; Comet tiny; Event Horizon high-risk; Singularity one verified Sol session.
Use Astral in Pulsar or Morph mode for this explicit opt-in request.
Use Astral in Constellation mode for an explicit opt-in independent-card request.
